key_reasoning.reason: The fix is in MarketplaceQueueService.decide(), the single compare-and-set write path for every marketplace transition. A users-row lookup (_recorded_user / _recorded_user_id) now gates three users-FK columns (assistants.marketplace_decided_by, mm_review_decision.decided_by_id, activity_events.actor_id), and an email fallback keeps the audit trail. The pattern already existed in _snapshot_actor. There is a subtle invariant: the idempotency key and the metric keep the raw id. The AC lists edge variants (no row with email, no row without email, row present), covered by a parameterized mock suite plus a real-PostgreSQL FK test. Existing templates (the mm_pg_engine fixture, mock-session decide tests) cover that defensive pattern, so there is no bump.

5 files changed (383+/25-): 1 service module modified (queue_service.py). 4 test files: 2 new (test_decide_recorded_user_id.py, test_withdraw_without_users_row_pg.py), 2 modified (test_record_activity_event.py, test_assistant_marketplace.py), across 2 test directories. The diffstat maps 4-6 files to M.
